title: Pact skill
wikitext:
{{Redirect|Pact|the divination card|The Pact}}

'''Pact''' skills are skills that empower specific types of [[spell]]s, with the downside of inflicting an [[Affliction (debuff)|Affliction]] debuff on you. Currently, all pact skills are also [[exceptional]] skill gems.

==Mechanics==
Pacts empower a number of future [[cast]]s, causing them to gain additional effects, comparable to the [[exerting]] mechanic for [[attack]] skills. Empowerments expire if not used within 15 seconds. 

[[Instant]] spells, [[Vaal skill|Vaal]] spells, and [[Brand]] spells cannot be empowered by default. [[Trigger]]ed skills also cannot be empowered, as empowerment requires casting.  

Afflictions are [[debuff]]s. {{il|Unholy Accomplice}} causes pacts to grant [[Affliction (debuff)#Boon|Boon]] [[buff]]s instead.

==Gems==
===Skill gems===
There are {{Drop enabled gem count|where=items.class_id="Active Skill Gem" AND skill_gems.gem_tags HOLDS "Pact"}} [[active skill gem]]s with the [[:Category:Pact (gem tag)|Pact]] [[gem tag]]:
{{Gem table
|where=items.class_id="Active Skill Gem"
   AND skill_gems.gem_tags HOLDS "Pact"
}}

===Support gems===
There are {{Drop enabled gem count|where=items.class_id="Support Skill Gem" AND skill_gems.gem_tags HOLDS "Pact"}} [[support skill gem]]s with the [[:Category:Pact (gem tag)|Pact]] [[gem tag]]:
{{Drop enabled gem table
|where=items.class_id="Support Skill Gem"
   AND skill_gems.gem_tags HOLDS "Pact"
}}

==Related unique items==
The following [[unique item]]s are related to Pact skills:
{{Drop enabled unique item table
|where=items.stat_text LIKE "%Pact%Skill%"
AND items.stat_text NOT LIKE "%Minion%Pact%"
|large=1
|base_item=1
|level=1
|stat=1
}}
